title.zh: 【Zcash 开发者开始将 Tachyon 扩容升级代码整合进隐私交易功能中】
title.en: 【Zcash 开发者开始将 Tachyon 扩容升级代码整合进隐私交易功能中】

current_state.zh: Zcash developers released the Udon component integrating Project Tachyon's scaling computation logic into the Zakura Common privacy transaction library, cutting test privacy-transaction creation times to under 200ms ahead of a long-term goal of 50,000+ private payments per second.
current_state.en: Zcash developers released the Udon component integrating Project Tachyon's scaling computation logic into the Zakura Common privacy transaction library, cutting test privacy-transaction creation times to under 200ms ahead of a long-term goal of 50,000+ private payments per second.
